articleTitle: Notes on the power-factor of the alternating-current arc
publicationTitle: Transactions of the American Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: The alternating-current (AC) arc presents a wide field for research because of the many variable elements. During the last year the effect of the wave-form of electromotive force applied to the terminals of a standard enclosed arc-lamp, and the elements affecting the power-factor, were studied in connection with the graduating thesis work of L.S. Billau, et al. at the University of Minnesota. Some of the results obtained seem of sufficient interest for presentation before the Institute.
